reasoning: Let a_n be the number of tilings of a 3×n rectangle. Looking at the leftmost column, either it is covered by one vertical tromino, leaving a 3×(n−1) rectangle, or all three cells begin horizontal trominoes, leaving a 3×(n−3) rectangle. Thus a_n=a_{n−1}+a_{n−3}, with a_0=a_1=a_2=1. The intermediate totals are a_3=2, a_4=3, a_5=4, a_6=6, a_7=9, a_8=13, a_9=19, a_10=28, a_11=41, and a_12=41+19=60.
